source_key_assessment: All250 current required assertions and all substantive expected/contextual statements checked against actual original authorities; no material source contradiction found. The three Final Confluence count branches, printed Detector nontrade exception, Network entry point, Star’s Ruin terminology and final-turn designer clarifications are verified natively/directly.
exact_scope_assessment: Current omission gates resolve actually requested outcomes, eligibility or procedure. Correct application outcomes exercise the governing rule. Do not impose extra formula, physical method, explanatory mechanism, already-given data or unmoved remainder recitations. Source-correct expected/contextual detail remains assessable for material contradictions. No current fact requires question expansion to rescue its scope.

per_question_findings.finding: Phase order and all-but-one boundary agree with booklet p6. Internal Confluence order and other boundary abilities remain context.
Seven-point loss applies the full p6 tariff to the stated undelivered goods. Negative scores permitted. No separate formula or already-performed partial delivery gate.
Background ownership governs one-turn loans; ordinary colonies and research teams transfer permanently. End-of-turn return is p9.

Trade invention, one complete alternative cost, team flip, immediate inventor entry and later matching entry/bonus are sourced. Normal sharing timing must not be converted into an extra standalone recitation of every exception; Q19/Q29 test those cases explicitly.
Named-card ownership sentence applies to that route. Spent card underneath and renamed-card ineligibility match pp6–7. Flipping and reuse limits are contextual here.
Support at Economy start, bottom-deck excess, optional once-only white converters and no output chaining match p7.
Donation storage, next-Trade disposal, mandatory receipt of a gift and donation-point tradeability match p7.

Current atoms correctly test secret allocation, double commitment, ordered simultaneous reveals, rank, payment, pass and tie priorities. Continued concealment of the retained pile after colony resolution is not explicit in those atoms; see independent coverage finding COV01.
Minimum-one cleanup, front-side-up bottom placement, left slide and top-deck refill match p8.
Final donation retention and three-point concrete total match p9. Correct result exercises scoring groups; no separate formula required. Final ties remain ties.
Five ships gives 2.5 effective colony bid without rounding. Bid-track seedling grant and persistence through trade/flip match Caylion.
Eni Et cannot run own interest converters but may upgrade them. Mixed input yields one preserved wild and three blue large cubes; outcome alone resolves asked output.
Non-Faderan transfer prohibition, mandatory one-token return per invention and two common-pool points for Faderan match sheet. Unmoved remaining token is not an extra gate.
Single shared shuffled face-down deck converter, Trade timing, once-per-turn deck activation and separate Detector cost/second-draw permission match sheet.
Every required support symbol, split/combine allocation and adequate supporting fleet loans match Im’dril; cards lacking symbols need no support.
Decision at normal buy/pass opportunity,3+2 split, no second split and updated colony count match Kjas. Later rank is asked explicitly in Q80, not extra gate here.
Fixed pairs, independent half upgrades, intact-pair loan, top Trade colony entry, permanent transfer and removed-from-game consumption match Kt.
Unity substitutions and mixed wild inputs match sheet, with theft immunity. Matching size is respected; no extra unrelated size narration required here.
No automatic Yengii sharing; same-Trade licensing of recipient matching library card is permanent and cannot restore hidden/spent cards.
After-Confluence theft, no duplicate target, actual-trade protection and three gift distinctions match Zeth.
Least experienced first, starred starts, accessible unshuffled library and symbol-defined deal recipients (two colonies for Kjas) match p3.

Six colony spots versus five research spots and actual-five-player Confluence set; separate-era stack and initial research deal order match p4. Species-card visible information is asked; physical flip is not separate.
Only points/bidding ships may be hidden; cards/resources visible. Goods not piece-limited and ship designs interchangeable. x5 handling is not separately required.
Multilateral contingent assent, binding future donation-point promise and two-point default match p6.
Ordinary earned points nontradable; nominal printed values do not waive converter costs. Donation-point exception is correct context.
Free no-input converters and the out-of-play violet entry exception match pp2,6–7. F02 and F03 can be satisfied by the same exception statement.
Either upgrade route, additional violet output and changing colony climate match source. Separate recitation of target flip/output growth is not required by these clauses.
Front-up colony-deck-bottom consumption, no reshuffle and discard-order cycling match p7.
Unique era-IV non-sharing and inventor immediate matching access match pp6,8.
Only brief bid-related negotiations; promises binding but actual transfers wait for Trade. Matches p8.
Purchasing above support is legal; next Trade gives disposal opportunity before the next Economy-start check.
Caylion half-ship effective bid cannot meet minimum one; research unhalved and all actual bid ships paid. Exact intermediary arithmetic is optional.
Seeded converter runs twice without chaining; upgrade unaffected and bottom-deck discard removes seedling. No extra simultaneous-method recital.
Caylion violet upgrade output occurs during Trade and yellow can immediately be traded.
All-wild interest input passes through unchanged without multiplying wilds; remainder one chosen ordinary color of matching size.
Original p2 deck icon visibly requires four white small cubes and jungle colony; consumed ordinary colony beneath deck. Native original atlas also corroborates.
Original Network card supplies entry point/top two colonies; sheet explicitly allows support loan and Im’dril support exception. Numeric +2 support and loan duration not separately asked.
Outside-held tokens at entry count; seven yields three points. Loan/trade does not change behavior. No separate ceiling algorithm gate.
Cache reduces cube-funded invention by one, not octagons; acknowledgment mandatory and normal Faderan points still apply.
Any-climate colony to two points, Trade max once and bottom-deck consumption match Faderan reverse.
Native Star’s Ruin uses current Sharing Bonus, resolving sheet’s Invention Bonus terminology. Six yields eight; subsequent trades do not retrigger entry.
First giver/Faderan beneficiaries, second-trade zero, no automatic return and Faderan-first all-rewards branch match complete cross-column sheet text.
Grindstone must spend preexisting point to pool; no points or same-Economy point cannot fund it. Positive preexisting-point branch legal.
Nonstarred fleet discovery in Trade gains one point. Winning colony bid alone does not let unsupported Im’dril keep colony into Economy.
Territory tiles start out, top enters, bottom flips, both Trade; card treatment and positive loan permission sourced.
Kt colony tie priority ignores larger colony holdings; unlimited support. Research counts still compare normally before Kt final tie win.

Any-climate Unity entry/upgrade, excess disposal by Economy start and top-converter computer-world entry sourced. One-support limit is scenario data, not independently tested or credited as a new procedural branch.
Two uncompleted teams count, inventions private/splayed in front, reduced upper-right bonus and normally incoming shared technologies sourced.
Entire Envoys factory output to one player, gifts not refused, spare-token gift ban and recipient circulation ban sourced. Accompanying token and positive stash trade are tested in Q77/Q78.
Only ordinary large cube is stealable, no second target to complete one converter, and envoy tokens not consumed. Correct concrete outcome exercises shortage and immunity rules.
One spent card only one upgrade and target flips. Underneath destination not an added requirement here.
Upgraded interest converters can remain usable without positive growth; ordinary blue/yellow mixture fails single-color condition.
Each half minimum/payment/pass result matches Kjas. Concrete cases exercise governing rule without separate general-method explanation.
Express donation trade can be refused; if accepted, actual Trade protects. Scenario already supplies clear statement.
Two small cubes plus ship form half-point group; large cannot join. Yes plus correct half-point outcome satisfies grouping atom without additional general formula.
Economy prohibits negotiation/speaking until everyone done and cannot execute Trade transfers there.
Actual matching species card determines outputs; research preview does not fix common colors across species.

Caylion starting seedling and no new grant merely for trade receipt are explicit on sheet.
Kt top entry converter has no other output; economic resources await Economy.
Matching-size gray wild eligible for Unity wild input; large wild cannot pay small input.
Printed four+three invention points give seven in Trade; six per invention gives twelve in Confluence, then matching entry/sharing precede colonies before research bids.
Resource-paid violet upgrade permission applies to in-play borrowed card; separate named-card route requires both with their owner. Contextual payment narration true, not an independent gate.
Agreed delivered substitute compensation is alternate resolution; default partial-fulfillment/penalty branch follows failed compensation agreement.
Starting quantities from species card; no initial converter Economy. First phase Trade.
Announce shared inventions, put technology cards face down in center, splay names readable. Explicitly asked record procedure.
Flip current Confluence card into shared splay, reverse shows remaining phases and ordinary continuation begins Trade; final counter respected.
Reveal hidden points; highest total wins. Tie rule separately Q10.
Zeth stolen ordinary cube color ignored; size and shape still constrain theft, and Unity wild immunity remains intact.
Positive Faderan acknowledgment-trading permission explicitly sourced.
Envoy-conditioned input eligibility depends on intended target’s holdings; own stash does not qualify unmarked target.
Ordinary white Economy/violet Trade timing and donation hand/violet-output marking match pp6–7.
Factory resources must go to same recipient accompanied by envoy token; positive mandatory companion transfer explicitly sourced.
Positive stash-token Trade permission explicitly sourced. Gift ban correct context; do not require extra recital here.
Both initial decks shuffled without looking; colony front-up and era-I research research-team-side-up match p3.
Each split half acts later at its own resulting bid rank, not both at original full-bid rank.
Original deck-output icon/sheet fixes top card and immediate play on resolution, rather than choice or delayed out-of-play holding.

coverage_stopping_assessment.conclusion: Stopping is not yet justified: the reserved/nonbidding ship pile’s concealment through the entire bid procedure is an explicit material information rule not discriminated by a current clause/fact.

findings.source: Original booklet p8 Bidding, allocation paragraph: retained third pile must stay hidden behind the screen until bidding is over. Native full PDF page8 and complete text read.
findings.missing_procedure: The nonbidding retained ship pile remains concealed throughout both bid rounds, including after colony resolution while research bids are still hidden.
findings.why_current_bank_does_not_discriminate: Q08.F01 asks secret initial division into three piles; F02 commits both bids and F06 controls the two bid reveals. None says what may happen to the third pile between the rounds. Q23 asks which goods may be hidden, not how long the reserve must remain hidden. Do not credit continued reserve concealment merely as background or as an unstated extension of initial secret division.
findings.material_consequence: Total ships are public before allocation. If the retained pile is exposed after the colony bid, opponents can deduce the unrevealed research bid before its simultaneous reveal. The source expressly prevents that information leak. This is a negative permission with a consequential timing boundary, not the incidental choice of fists versus screen.

proposed_question.question: After colony bids have resolved but before research bids are revealed, may a player expose the ships in their retained, nonbidding pile, or must those ships remain hidden until both bid rounds finish?

proposed_key.expected_answer: Keep the retained third pile hidden behind the screen until bidding is over, including throughout research bidding. Do not expose it between the colony and research rounds.

required_facts.fact: The retained nonbidding ship pile stays hidden until both bid rounds are over; it may not be exposed between colony resolution and research reveal.

contextual_background: Revealing the reserve would let others deduce the still-hidden research bid from the announced total and revealed colony bid; explaining that deduction is not a separate omission gate.
source_references: Original2017 rulebook p8 Bidding, allocation paragraph

findings.exact_scope: Only the reserve’s concealment duration and the between-round permission are required. Do not require fists, hand position, additional bid amounts, deduction arithmetic or a complete repeat of the full bid procedure.
findings.recommended_action: Reopen coverage; add the explicit outcome question/key/scope and map this source procedure to its actual asked fact, then perform fresh source stopping checks.
